svg.title: Ablation: estimated generation cost and recorded latency

cc:Work.dc:title: Ablation: estimated generation cost and recorded latency
cc:Work.dc:description: Experiment: 11 Nov 2026; Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite; horizon=100 turns. 40 base tasks x 2 repeats per condition; repeats are not independent tasks. Legacy v1.0.3 no_temporal removes BOTH temporal resolution and mandatory state. Cost bars use saved 95% CI scaled to 1,000 runs; this is a rate, not an actual 1,000-run experiment or total bill. Latency bars have no invented CI; OS and commit differ, so differences are not a causal budget effect. Sources: docs/results/ablation_2k_h100_20261111/summary.json; docs/experiments/reports/ablation-2k-h100-analysis-2026-11-11.md

g.text: Ablation: estimated generation cost and recorded latency
ablation_05_cost_and_latency | Experiment: 11 Nov 2026; Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite; horizon=100 turns. 40 base tasks x 2 repeats per condition; repeats are not independent tasks. Legacy v1.0.3
no_temporal removes BOTH temporal resolution and mandatory state. Cost bars use saved 95% CI scaled to 1,000 runs; this is a rate, not an actual 1,000-run experiment or total bill. Latency bars
have no invented CI; OS and commit differ, so differences are not a causal budget effect.
